source: 敵の小型戦艦 20 種類の追加用 90 枚 (シート 84〜93、ユーザーが別に生成した画像)。効果と小物
style: Small hostile warships of the "Void fleet" in a stylised sci-fi space game: dark gunmetal, angular, worn, with glowing accent lights. PICTURE cells: ONE item or scene seen exactly straight on (or from directly above), filling the cell, flat even light, no readable text, letters, numbers or real-world logos. CUTOUT-style PICTURE cells say "on plain pure white background": draw only the object or emblem, centred, on flat pure white with no shadow. Tiles are flat, evenly lit and seamless.

cells.name: en-shield-hex
cells.prompt: An energy shield surface: glowing violet hexagon grid on black, front-on.

cells.name: en-engine-plume
cells.prompt: A rocket engine exhaust plume seen from the side: blue-white core fading to violet, on black.

cells.name: en-muzzle-flash
cells.prompt: A cannon muzzle flash: bright star-shaped burst of orange and white, on black.

cells.name: en-battle-damage
cells.prompt: Battle-damaged hull: torn dark plates, scorch marks and exposed glowing wires.

cells.name: en-sparks
cells.prompt: A shower of electric sparks, bright yellow-white, on black.

cells.name: en-holo-warning
cells.prompt: A red holographic warning sign: a triangle with an exclamation mark and scan lines, on black.

cells.name: en-escape-pod
cells.prompt: A small capsule-shaped escape pod with a round window and fins. On plain pure white background.

cells.name: en-cargo-crate
cells.prompt: A dark grey military cargo crate with violet stripes and handles, front-on.

cells.name: en-hazard-floor
cells.prompt: Yellow and black hazard floor markings on dark worn steel, diagonal.
